limitations: Fixed finite dimension and fixed real perturbation; weights strictly positive near a common baseline; 1<p<infinity; local second-order law only. The p=2 subcase follows from classical eigenvalue perturbation. The original 2012 full publisher PDF was not available for complete inspection, leaving residual bibliographic uncertainty about alternate formulations. No independent audit has been carried out.
scientific_integrity: All universal assertions are derived analytically from simplex reduction, a negative-definite Hessian on the mean-zero tangent space, and exact cycle-Laplacian spectral bounds. Finite computational checks are independent corroboration, not infinite certificates.
title: Universal Green-kernel Hessian for the numerical radius of cyclic shifts on \(\ell_p\)
